verdicts.reading: Large language models of the GPT-3 kind (text- and code-writing LLMs) are usable now (2021) and in routine use by their main professional users, software developers, by 2023 (placed 2021 + 2).
verdicts.reason: Both graders agree on the facts: US adults who had used ChatGPT were 18% in July 2023 (Pew), below 20%, and 34% by Feb-Mar 2025. The dispute is the base. The entry's own framing is a developer platform (API, apps built on it, code generation), so routine use by the relevant industry is the dominant D16 test. Stack Overflow 2023 (survey May 2023): 44% of respondents already use AI tools in their development process (26% more plan to), and 83% of AI-search users used ChatGPT, 55% of AI-dev-tool users Copilot (both GPT-family). That is above 20% of the industry within the +2 window: hit. Grader B cited the 70% 'use or plan to use' figure; the currently-using figure (44%, Stack Overflow blog) is the right one and still clears the bar. Grader A's general-public base is a valid secondary test and is borderline rather than clearly late (Pew's next reading, Feb 2024, was 23%), so it does not dominate.

verdicts.reading: Sequencing ancient human DNA is now (2023) a routine, production-scale method for reconstructing human population history.
verdicts.reason: Grader B is right that no survey gives the share of archaeology projects using ancient DNA (one search for a bibliometric share found none). But D22 applies when no public measure of what the claim states exists, and this claim states a capability in routine use, which is measured: the Allen Ancient DNA Resource records about 10 individuals per year with genome-wide data in 2010-2014, about 200 per year in 2015-2017 and thousands per year since 2018, passing 10,000 by end-2022; the entry itself gives 5 (2010) to 5,550 (2020) whole-genome individuals. In the relevant field, studies of ancient human population history, genome-wide aDNA is the standard method at the placed year, the same routine-use-in-its-community test the consensus applied to JWST and Rubin. Hit; least certain call, as the share of the wider archaeology field is unmeasured.

evidence.title: The Allen Ancient DNA Resource (AADR): a curated compendium of ancient human genomes (Scientific Data 11:182)
evidence.shows: >10,000 individuals with published genome-wide aDNA data by end-2022; ~10/yr 2010-2014, ~200/yr 2015-2017, thousands/yr since 2018.
